name: @qf-jarvis/riya-intelligence-dataset
description: QF Jarvis Riya intelligence dataset foundation and leakage firewall (RID-F1, ADR-0107). The OFFLINE dataset factory for Riya post-training: the canonical multi-turn TRAJECTORY is the source of truth, and model-specific training rows are DERIVED from it rather than authored. It trains nothing and invokes nothing -- no model, provider, gateway, local inference, HTTP, LLM-as-judge, embeddings, vector store, tokenizer, PyTorch, PEFT/LoRA/QLoRA/TRL, checkpoint or training loop, and no dataset item can auto-start a run. Splits are TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT and are isolated by LINEAGE, so every synthetic variant of an example stays with its root; the protected RWC-P10 golden corpus is exam data and is NOT a split, with exact-copy rejection and deterministic near-copy quarantine that uses token overlap rather than any model. Sources are synthetic only -- live chat, CRM and WhatsApp exports are not representable -- and deterministic privacy/secret gates reject email, phone, API key, bearer/service-role token, private key, UPI-like handle, URL and governed production-domain strings without ever echoing the matched text. Volatile business truth stays OUT of weights: an assistant turn asserting a price, availability, policy or warranty must cite a fact supplied by an EARLIER synthetic authoritative context. Reviews are risk-based and content-free. Dataset artifacts carry cryptographic SHA-256 content identity via node:crypto -- integrity, not authorship -- and release evidence is always syntheticOnly with trainingApproval=false. No database, no migration, no deployment, no QuickFurno data. Depends on @qf-jarvis/riya-conversation-continuity, @qf-jarvis/riya-conversation-evolution, @qf-jarvis/riya-quality-evaluation and zod. Also ships an OFFLINE ./ai-synthetic subpath carrying the AI-synthetic training lane (AS1, ADR-0143): the structured generation SCENARIO (a plan with no field a sentence fits in, whose lineage and split are fixed BEFORE generation), content-free generation provenance naming the separated planner/simulator/teacher/verifier roles, a critic verdict with no rationale or score, versioned automated-acceptance and anti-formula diversity policies in basis points, per-trajectory acceptance evidence bound to the trajectory and scenario DIGESTS, a forward-only candidate state machine in which QUARANTINED never becomes ACCEPTED, deterministic diversity metrics, and an automated validator that REUSES the generic dataset validator and sets aside only the human-review blocker, only for a wholly TEACHER_GENERATED_SYNTHETIC corpus with valid evidence. It calls no model and fabricates no review; HUMAN_AUTHORED_SYNTHETIC is never applied to model-written text, generic human-review semantics are unchanged, and its release evidence is a separate identity that is never presented as human-reviewed P10 and still carries trainingApproval=false. AS1-B (ADR-0144) adds a SECOND, explicit provenance mode for candidates generated outside this repository -- EXTERNAL_MANUAL_SYNTHETIC_INTAKE, binding intake contract, batch, producer family, producer teacher and the source candidate/trajectory/bundle digests, and claiming no AS2 run id, config inventory allocation, planner config or simulator config it never had; the delivery digests it CLAIMS (raw bytes: the JSONL record without its line terminator, and the bundle file as received) are corroborated at validation time against a separate observed external source binding, because provenanceSha256 proves only that a claim did not change afterwards and never that it was true -- plus a deterministic verifier run record binding verifier identity, implementation and scope versions, the verified trajectory digest, the deterministic report digest and a closed PASSED/FAILED verdict, which a bare config ref or a model configuration cannot stand in for. The historical in-repo provenance record and every acceptance evidence digest already issued are unchanged; the external route is gated by the same evidence, scenario, critic-independence and required-quality-dimension rules plus a verifier run it cannot skip, no historical critic artifact is grandfathered, no protected P10 material is reachable, and trainingApproval remains false. Ships an OFFLINE ./gold-v1 subpath carrying the Human Gold V1 authoring system (HGV1-A, ADR-0108): the exact 360-slot plan as five balanced waves of 72, the 72 Wave-1 authoring briefs, the Gold coverage and release policies, plan/brief/corpus validators, a content-free authoring progress board and formula-degeneration metrics. It contains NO Gold dialogue -- briefs are writing assignments with no field a sentence fits in -- and Gold provenance is enforced: teacher-generated trajectories never count toward Human Gold, whoever approved them.
